name: Knotwork Wood
description: Pale ash, braided iron, leather bindings, and an antler direction needle.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Cardinal letters are baked into the fixed iron ring. The broad antler needle has 2.75x the opaque mass of the blue-green feather.

orientationConventions.ring: Static north-up braided-iron card. N is baked into the top leather binding.
orientationConventions.headingPointer: The broad antler point faces 12 o'clock at heading 0. Its iron boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure player world bearing.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The blue-green feather tip points to 12 o'clock at wind bearing 0. Its quill pivot is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure wind-toward world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Optional static top accent for the north index. It does not replace the heading pointer.
